items.t: Altria Has Until Christmas Eve to Bid for $34 Billion Imperial Brands
items.sum: Marlboro's maker just admitted it is eyeing a global rival, yet it has no price, no partner, and a clock running down. A heavy dividend and a possible Japanese competitor could turn this expansion into a trap for Altria shareholders.

items.t: Altria’s Interest in Imperial May Affect Its AB InBev Stake
items.sum: A possible three-way deal to reshape the global tobacco industry may also spill over into another business whose products are sometimes consumed alongside cigarettes — beer.
